7.content:
## Helpful Info ##

The Observability (OBS) Score is a maturity metric designed to quantify how "visible" an application is within your ecosystem. Instead of simply measuring if an application is "up" or "down," it measures the breadth of telemetry types (metrics, traces, logs, and synthetics) being captured.
This score allows leadership to identify high-risk "blind spots"—applications that are running in production but have little to no monitoring data available for troubleshooting or performance analysis.
The 5-Point Calculation Logic
The score is calculated on a scale of 0 to 5. Each point represents a fundamental "pillar" of modern observability. If the logic detects at least one entity of that type associated with the application's Shortname, a point is awarded.


## The 5-Point Calculation Logic ##
Points Pillar Logic / Requirement
+1 Infrastructure : OneAgent (Host) Active: At least one host or container is reporting hardware/OS metrics.
+1 Services : Traces/Services: Distributed tracing is active, capturing code-level transactions and failure rates.
+1 Logs : Log Ingestion: Log data has been seen in the last 24 hours (crucial for forensic debugging).
+1 Synthetics : Digital Experience: At least one Browser, HTTP, or Multi-Protocol check is verifying availability.
+1 Full Stack : Correlation Bonus: Awarded if the app has both Infrastructure AND Service monitoring active simultaneously.

## Understanding the Score Results ##
The score acts as a "Maturity Grade" for the application's integration into Dynatrace:
Score 0 (No Coverage): Critical Risk. The app exists in your business records, but Dynatrace has zero active signals. You are "flying blind."
Score 1–2 (Reactive): Basic monitoring is present (e.g., just logs or just a heartbeat check), but you lack the context to find the root cause of an issue quickly.
Score 3–4 (Proactive): Good coverage. You likely have infrastructure and service data, but might be missing synthetic "outside-in" testing or log correlation.
Score 5 (Observability Leader): The Gold Standard. You have 360-degree visibility, from the host up to the user transaction, backed by automated testing and logs.

## Why Logs are Treated Differently ##
Logs contribute to the Obs Score (improving the grade), but they do not count as "Active Monitoring" for the status indicator.
This is because logs are "passive"—they tell you what happened after a crash. OneAgent, Traces, and Synthetics are "active"—they provide real-time health signals. An application with only logs will show a Score of 1, but will still be flagged with a warning icon.

27.query:
fetch dt.entity.host
| limit 100000
| filter lifetime[end] > asTimestamp(now()-2h)
| fieldsAdd tags, monitoringMode
| fields tags = toString(tags), entity.name, id, hostGroupName
| parse tags, """DATA* 
            'ocation:'
            DATA:Region
            '"'"""
| parse tags, """DATA* 
            'hortname'
             DATA*
            ':'
            DATA:Shortname
            '"'"""
| append [fetch dt.entity.service
            | expand tags
            | filter matchesPhrase(tags, "Shortname")// or 
                | parse tags, """DATA* 
            'ocation:'
            DATA:Region
            '"'"""
| parse tags, """DATA* 
            'hortname'
             DATA*
            ':'
            DATA:Shortname
            '"'"""
                        | fieldsAdd `join_key` = lower(trim(Shortname)), id
            | filter isNotNull(`join_key`)
            | fields entity.name, `entity.id` = id, `Shortnames` = `join_key`, Region
            ]  


| filterOut isNull(Region)
| fields entity.name, Region, Shortname, id, tags, hostGroupName
| fieldsAdd Shortname=lower(Shortname)


| fieldsAdd Region = if(matchesPhrase(Region, "east"), "Eastus", else: Region)
| fieldsAdd Region = if(matchesPhrase(Region, "west") or matchesPhrase(Region, "weus"), "Westus", else: Region)
| fieldsAdd Region = if(matchesPhrase(Region, "sv7") or matchesPhrase(Region, "sv8"), "DFW", else: Region)
| fieldsAdd Region = if(matchesPhrase(Region, "dfw") or matchesPhrase(Region, "dal") or matchesPhrase(Region, "day"), "DFW", else: Region)
| fieldsAdd Region = if(matchesPhrase(Region, "cdc"), "CDC", else: Region)
| fieldsAdd Region = if(matchesPhrase(Region, "pdc"), "PDC", else: Region)
| fieldsAdd Region = if(matchesPhrase(Region, "phx"), "PHX", else: Region)

| fields Region = lower(Region), hostGroupName, id, tags
| filterout matchesPhrase(hostGroupName, "*syntheticapm*")
| summarize count = count(), by:{Region}
| filterout Region == "eastus, westus"

68.title: MTTR Trend (2 months)
68.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems, from:now()-60d
| fieldsAdd period = if(timestamp > now()-30d, "curr", else: "prev"), dur = toLong(resolved_problem_duration)
| summarize {curr_raw = avg(if(period=="curr", dur, else:null)), prev_raw = avg(if(period=="prev", dur, else:null))}
| fieldsAdd curr_min = coalesce(curr_raw,0) / 60000000000, prev_min = coalesce(prev_raw,0) / 60000000000
| fieldsAdd trend_raw = ((toDouble(curr_min) - toDouble(prev_min)) / toDouble(prev_min)) * 100
| fieldsAdd `Current MTTR (30d)` = concat(toLong(curr_min), " min"), `Previous MTTR (60d)` = concat(toLong(prev_min), " min"), `Trend %` = concat(if(trend_raw > 0, "+", else: ""), round(trend_raw, decimals:1), "%"), `Trend Status` = if(trend_raw > 0, "🔴", else: if(trend_raw < 0, "✅", else: ":white_circle:"))
| fields  `Trend %`, `Trend Status`, `Previous MTTR (60d)`, `Current MTTR (30d)`

69.title: Problems Trend (2 months)
69.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems, from:now()-60d
| fieldsAdd is_curr = if(timestamp > now()-30d, 1, else: 0), is_prev = if(timestamp <= now()-30d, 1, else: 0)
| summarize curr_p = sum(is_curr), prev_p = sum(is_prev)
| fieldsAdd trend_raw = ((toDouble(curr_p) - toDouble(prev_p)) / toDouble(prev_p)) * 100
| fieldsAdd `Current Problems (30d)` = curr_p, `Previous Problems (60d)` = prev_p, `Trend %` = concat(if(trend_raw > 0, "+", else: ""), round(trend_raw, decimals:1), "%"), `Trend Status` = if(trend_raw > 0, "🔴", else: if(trend_raw < 0, "✅", else: ":white_circle:"))
| fields  `Trend %`, `Trend Status`, `Previous Problems (60d)`, `Current Problems (30d)`

fetch dt.davis.problems, from:now()-730d
| fieldsAdd period = if(timestamp > now()-365d, "curr", else: "prev"), dur = toLong(resolved_problem_duration)
| summarize {curr_raw = avg(if(period=="curr", dur, else:null)), prev_raw = avg(if(period=="prev", dur, else:null))}
| fieldsAdd curr_min = coalesce(curr_raw,0) / 60000000000, prev_min = coalesce(prev_raw,0) / 60000000000
| fieldsAdd trend_raw = ((toDouble(curr_min) - toDouble(prev_min)) / toDouble(prev_min)) * 100
| fieldsAdd `Current MTTR (Year)` = concat(toLong(curr_min), " min"), `Previous MTTR (Last Year)` = concat(toLong(prev_min), " min"), `Trend %` = concat(if(trend_raw > 0, "+", else: ""), round(trend_raw, decimals:1), "%"), `Status` = if(trend_raw > 0, "🔴", else: if(trend_raw < 0, "🟢", else: "⚪"))
| fields `Trend %`, `Status`, `Previous MTTR (Last Year)`, `Current MTTR (Year)`

78.title: Problem History
78.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems, from:now()-1y
| fieldsAdd m = formatTimestamp(timestamp, format:"yyyy-MM"), id = display_id
| summarize `Apr 25` = countDistinct(if(m == "2025-04", id, else:null)), `May 25` = countDistinct(if(m == "2025-05", id, else:null)), `Jun 25` = countDistinct(if(m == "2025-06", id, else:null)), `Jul 25` = countDistinct(if(m == "2025-07", id, else:null)), `Aug 25` = countDistinct(if(m == "2025-08", id, else:null)), `Sep 25` = countDistinct(if(m == "2025-09", id, else:null)), `Oct 25` = countDistinct(if(m == "2025-10", id, else:null)), `Nov 25` = countDistinct(if(m == "2025-11", id, else:null)), `Dec 25` = countDistinct(if(m == "2025-12", id, else:null)), `Jan 26` = countDistinct(if(m == "2026-01", id, else:null)), `Feb 26` = countDistinct(if(m == "2026-02", id, else:null)), `Mar 26` = countDistinct(if(m == "2026-03", id, else:null))

| summarize `a25` = round(avg(if(m == "2025-04", dur, else:null)), decimals:1), `m25` = round(avg(if(m == "2025-05", dur, else:null)), decimals:1), `jn25` = round(avg(if(m == "2025-06", dur, else:null)), decimals:1), `jl25` = round(avg(if(m == "2025-07", dur, else:null)), decimals:1), `au25` = round(avg(if(m == "2025-08", dur, else:null)), decimals:1), `s25` = round(avg(if(m == "2025-09", dur, else:null)), decimals:1), `o25` = round(avg(if(m == "2025-10", dur, else:null)), decimals:1), `n25` = round(avg(if(m == "2025-11", dur, else:null)), decimals:1), `d25` = round(avg(if(m == "2025-12", dur, else:null)), decimals:1), `j26` = round(avg(if(m == "2026-01", dur, else:null)), decimals:1), `f26` = round(avg(if(m == "2026-02", dur, else:null)), decimals:1), `mr26` = round(avg(if(m == "2026-03", dur, else:null)), decimals:1)
| fieldsAdd `Apr 25` = if(isNotNull(a25), concat(a25, " min"), else: "0 min"), `May 25` = if(isNotNull(m25), concat(m25, " min"), else: "0 min"), `Jun 25` = if(isNotNull(jn25), concat(jn25, " min"), else: "0 min"), `Jul 25` = if(isNotNull(jl25), concat(jl25, " min"), else: "0 min"), `Aug 25` = if(isNotNull(au25), concat(au25, " min"), else: "0 min"), `Sep 25` = if(isNotNull(s25), concat(s25, " min"), else: "0 min"), `Oct 25` = if(isNotNull(o25), concat(o25, " min"), else: "0 min"), `Nov 25` = if(isNotNull(n25), concat(n25, " min"), else: "0 min"), `Dec 25` = if(isNotNull(d25), concat(d25, " min"), else: "0 min"), `Jan 26` = if(isNotNull(j26), concat(j26, " min"), else: "0 min"), `Feb 26` = if(isNotNull(f26), concat(f26, " min"), else: "0 min"), `Mar 26` = if(isNotNull(mr26), concat(mr26, " min"), else: "0 min")
| fields `Apr 25`, `May 25`, `Jun 25`, `Jul 25`, `Aug 25`, `Sep 25`, `Oct 25`, `Nov 25`, `Dec 25`, `Jan 26`, `Feb 26`, `Mar 26`
